cases.sentence: Он будут ходить со мной в белых ___
cases.translation: They will walk with me in white garments
cases.explain: After the preposition 'в' (in), nouns take the prepositional case

cases.sentence: я не вычеркну его имени из ___ жизни
cases.translation: I will not blot his name out of the book of life
cases.explain: After the preposition 'из' (from), nouns take the genitive case

cases.sentence: признаю его перед моим отцом и перед его ___
cases.translation: I will confess his name before my Father and before His angels
cases.explain: The preposition 'перед' (before) requires the instrumental case

cases.translation: he who has the key of David
cases.explain: The verb 'владеющий' (owning, having) requires the instrumental case

cases.sentence: Его закрывает, и никто не откроет ___ царя Давида
cases.translation: the key of the king David
cases.explain: Possessive nouns in the genitive case show possession or association

cases.sentence: Тех из сатанинского ___, кто называет себя иудеями
cases.translation: Those from the synagogue of Satan
cases.explain: After the preposition 'из' (from), nouns take the genitive case

cases.sentence: я сохраню тебя от ___ испытаний, который придет на весь мир
cases.translation: I will keep you from the hour of testing
cases.explain: The preposition 'от' (from) requires the genitive case

cases.translation: testing which comes upon the whole world
cases.explain: After the preposition 'на' (upon), accusative nouns express direction or extent

reading.ru: Я знаю твои дела, а тебе говорят, будто ты жив, но ты мертв.
reading.question: What is said about the spiritual condition of the church in Sardis?
options: They are spiritually alive and growing
They appear alive but are spiritually dead
reading.correct: They appear alive but are spiritually dead
reading.explain: The text states: 'а тебе говорят, будто ты жив, но ты мертв' (you have a reputation of being alive, but you are dead)

reading.ru: Однако у тебя в Сардах есть немного людей, которые не запятнали свои одежды.
reading.question: What is said about some people in Sardis?
options: They have abandoned the faith entirely
They have defiled their garments through sin
They have not defiled their garments
They are the leaders of the church
reading.correct: They have not defiled their garments
reading.explain: The text explicitly states: 'которые не запятнали свои одежды' (who did not defile their garments)

reading.ru: Я знаю твои дела. Смотри, вот я открыл перед тобой дверь, которую никто не может закрыть.
reading.question: What has been opened before the church in Philadelphia?
options: An open door that no one can close
reading.correct: An open door that no one can close
reading.explain: The text says: 'я открыл перед тобой дверь, которую никто не может закрыть' (I have set before you an open door, which no one can shut)

reading.ru: Я знаю, что у тебя мало сил, но ты все же держался моего слова и не отрекся от моего имени.
reading.question: What is true about the church in Philadelphia despite their weakness?
options: They have become strong and powerful
They have kept His word and not denied His name
They have lost their faith and hope
They have grown wealthy and influential
reading.correct: They have kept His word and not denied His name
reading.explain: The text states: 'ты все же держался моего слова и не отрекся от моего имени' (you kept my word and did not deny my name)

reading.ru: Я знаю твои дела. Ты не холоден, не горяч.
reading.question: What is the spiritual condition of the church in Laodicea?
options: They are spiritually hot and fervent
They are spiritually cold but honest
They are neither cold nor hot, but lukewarm
They are perfectly balanced in faith
reading.correct: They are neither cold nor hot, but lukewarm
reading.explain: The text says: 'Ты не холоден, не горяч' (you are neither cold nor hot), which means they are lukewarm

reading.ru: Ты говоришь, 'Я богат, я много приобрел, и мне уже ничего не надо'. Но ты не осознаешь, что ты несчастен, жалок, нищ, слеп и гол.
reading.question: What is the reality behind the church's claims of wealth?
options: They are truly rich and successful
They are materially poor but spiritually rich
They are actually wretched, miserable, poor, blind, and naked
reading.correct: They are actually wretched, miserable, poor, blind, and naked
reading.explain: The text contrasts their claim of wealth with the reality: 'ты несчастен, жалок, нищ, слеп и гол' (you are wretched, miserable, poor, blind, and naked)
